# VelaBuilt

> A creative technology studio building premium websites, follow-up systems and
> intelligent digital infrastructure for modern businesses.

VelaBuilt designs the experience and builds the infrastructure underneath it.
Websites, automation and AI systems are the capabilities; the three items under
"Solutions" are what a business actually buys.

This file is a convenience for machine readers. It is not the source of truth:
every statement here is also stated in semantic HTML and structured data on the
pages linked below.

## Solutions

- [Website Conversion System](/website-conversion-systems): A premium website
  rebuilt around trust and inquiry — positioning, design, user experience,
  performance and the conversion path from first visit to first contact. For
  businesses whose website no longer reflects the quality of the work, or leaves
  visitors unsure what to do next.
- [Lead Follow-Up & Recovery System](/lead-follow-up-systems): Infrastructure
  that catches every inquiry, qualifies it, follows it up on a schedule and puts
  the right conversations in the calendar without anyone remembering to. For
  businesses already receiving inquiries that lose opportunities to inconsistent
  follow-up.
- [Website Engine Optimization](/website-engine-optimization): Technical
  foundations and information architecture that make a business straightforward
  for people, search engines and AI systems to find, read and describe
  correctly. For businesses that are hard to find, or described inaccurately.

## Studio

- [System Lab](/system-lab): Interactive demonstrations of the modules VelaBuilt
  builds — CRM, booking, follow-up, email, messaging, pipeline, calendar, AI
  assistance, business data and analytics — including what each hands off to and
  what a person still decides.
- [Approach](/approach): How a project runs, and the principles held to.
- [About](/about): What VelaBuilt is, who it works with, and what it does not claim.
- [Work](/work): Concept studies and system demonstrations, each labeled.
- [Start a project](/start): The inquiry form.
- [Privacy](/privacy): What the site collects and why.

## What VelaBuilt does not claim

- No client results are published that cannot be evidenced.
- Work labeled CONCEPT is a study, not a delivered client project.
- Work labeled SYSTEM DEMO uses sample data, not real customer records.
- No performance, revenue or ranking guarantees are made anywhere on the site.
- At the time of writing there is no published client work; the site launched
  with concepts and demonstrations rather than invented case studies.
